title: No Good Therapy presents "No Mas," a passionate musical protest against injustice
htmlContent: No Good Therapy is back, and they're not holding back. Their newest song, "No Mas," is like a protest, a raw shout against the Trump administration's inhumanity and planned unfairness. The band makes it clear with this release that they won't stay quiet while things are unfair. "No Mas" makes it clear that No Good Therapy is not only a band, but also a voice and conscience in troubled times. https://open.spotify.com/track/4AcCO7OUm1dzRWokchvx7x "No Mas" is a call to action. Every beat, lyric, and riff of No Good Therapy is filled with righteous anger. This makes for a raw, unfiltered musical statement that can't be ignored. Their message is simple but powerful. The band calls out how people treat each other with an honesty that is both shocking and necessary. They refuse to soften their words to make them more comfortable or more appealing to the general public. The song is a work of art that shows frustration, empathy, and moral outrage. The energy of the song grabs people's attention and makes them think, and maybe even act. It's a reminder that music can be a powerful way to tell the truth, a place where anger and creativity meet, and a place where art won't look away. They've turned their anger into something loud, raw, and hard to ignore. Follow No Good Therapy on Instagram and Facebook
